{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Extract and print each mean value explicitly to ensure they are captured in output
adlie_mean = mean_flipper_by_species['Adelie']
chinstrap_mean = mean_flipper_by_species['Chinstrap']
gentoo_mean = mean_flipper_by_species['Gentoo']

# Print each mean with exactly two decimal places as required
print(f"Adelie mean flipper length: {adlie_mean:.2f} mm")
print(f"Chinstrap mean flipper length: {chinstrap_mean:.2f} mm")
print(f"Gentoo mean flipper length: {gentoo_mean:.2f} mm")

# Also print the full series to confirm
print("\nFull mean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)"}
